card.name: Inhibitor after enzyme names
card.fires_on: The capitalized start of the word Inhibitors right after an enzyme name, mostly Monoamine Oxidase, in drug-interaction headings. It also fires on the start of ophthalmic after a drug name.

modes.label: Enzyme inhibitor headings
modes.description: The word Inhibitor(s) is split, and the pole fires on its first piece after Monoamine Oxidase or Angiotensin-converting Enzyme.
